buildCommand: npm --prefix site install --no-audit --no-fund && npm --prefix site run build && rm -rf site/dist/data site/dist/api site/dist/build-* && cp -r docs/data site/dist/data && cp -r docs/api site/dist/api && for d in docs/data/builds/*; do cp -r "$d" "site/dist/build-$(basename "$d")"; done
